## ⏰ The clock on this card is now identified, not hypothetical

`.changeset/plain-donkeys-repeat.md` is consumed — status `removed` — by the **open, non-draft** Version Packages PR **#17076**. Read by paginating all 400 changed files (296 changesets); ⛔ the first page of 100 does not contain it, so a single-page read would have reported it absent.

⚠️ Precisely, and ⛔ not escalated past the reading: #17076 carries **no auto-merge**, and was last updated 2026-09-13T18:13Z. 「挂着的发布 PR 是常态,⛔ 默认永不催」 ⇒ this is **not** the "release PR observed moving" trigger that triage's own grading comment (`5656331532`) says would make this p0. It stays **p1**. What changed is only that the closing event has a name and is sitting open.

## Premise re-verified on `origin/main` at claim time, ⛔ not carried from the card

| premise | reading |
|---|---|
| changeset still pending | present on `origin/main`, declaring exactly `'@objectstack/spec': minor` |
| `BREAKING` → 0 | 0 |
| `adr-0087` → 0 | 0 |
| the zero is a real negative | **lit control on the same predicate**: `.changeset/15110-retired-element-node-refusal.md` → 1 |
| window still open | `packages/spec` `package.json` version **17.4.0** |

⇒ all hold. The correction is still a one-file change rather than a second breaking event.

## ⚠️ One thing the dev must settle FIRST, as a premise rather than an instruction

Whether declaring this breaking **requires** an ADR-0087 semantic entry is a **PM mechanism assumption, not a ruling** — verify it and report. The recorded behaviour of `check-adr-0087-registration` is that it judges *declared-breaking changesets only*, and prints `✓ this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset` when there is nothing to look at (measured on PR #17913 — a green that was vacuous). ⇒ adding the BREAKING declaration is exactly what arms that gate. If it then demands a registration, the file surface above covers it; **if it does not, ⛔ do not invent one** — the smaller diff is the right one, and say so in the report.

### ⛔ Two corrections this seat owes, both of them mine

**1. My dispatch order was wrong about #18064, and the dev was right to say so.** I wrote that #18064 was an open `needs-user-decision` card and instructed the dev to return `needs_decision` if the level question touched it. Read live: **closed / `completed` at 2026-09-14T00:36:28Z, labels `priority:p2` + `domain:spec` only — no `needs-user-decision`.** It had closed ~3h before I wrote the claim, and I carried it from a lane listing taken at 00:14Z instead of re-reading the card. That is exactly the rule 「⛔ 写入前对每张卡现读当前状态;任何列表快照读数一律作废」, and I broke it. ⭐ The mechanism assumption was written into the dispatch as falsifiable and the dev falsified it — the protocol worked; my reading did not.

**2. My own verification produced a false negative, and I nearly graded the card on it.** Checking the dev's cited authority I grepped `origin/main` for *"not the carrier of breaking-ness"* and got **0**, with a lit control that passed — which looked like a fabricated citation. It is not. The ADR text breaks the line mid-phrase and emphasises the word: `The level is\n*not* the carrier of breaking-ness during the window`. My control word shared the corpus but **not the failure mode** — 「同主体 = 同语料、同路径形、同包界、同引法、同失效形态:跨行短语配跨行控制词」. The citation is accurate and the authority is on `main`: ADR-0087, *Ratified: the pre-launch launch-window exemption*, **Amended 2026-09-13 (#18003)** — 「Pre-GA, a metadata-facing retirement or break ships `minor`, carrying the `**BREAKING**` banner and its ADR-0087 disposition entry」.

⇒ the level decision is not the dev's judgement call at all; it is what the amended ADR prescribes, and that amendment exists precisely because two director rulings came out opposite on this question (#16929 `minor` vs #16885 `major`).
